set.body: Fan-in gap found in M8. The active GDS-backed group_data() (R/group_data_gds.R, via fmrigds::gds) cannot aggregate write_results() output for any format: (1) NIfTI - fmrigds:::.nifti_subject_key strips only a TRAILING stat token, but BIDS names put the stat in a desc- infix before _bold, so beta/se files never pair ('beta and se files must refer to the same subjects'); subjects= does not bypass the pre-check. (2) h5 - multi-file stacking errors 'length(name)==1 is not TRUE'; format=auto silently reads only the first file. (3) fmrilm - maps to tabular, 'invalid file argument'; group_data_from_fmrilm builds a group_data_h5-shaped object backed by lm_list but there is NO fmri_meta.group_data_fmrilm (dispatches to .group_data_h5 which needs on-disk paths/labels). Only working path today: legacy group_data_from_nifti(beta_paths,se_paths,subjects)+fmri_meta.group_data_nifti (both .Deprecated), requires a formula-embedded contrast so beta+se are written. M8 test uses that path. Fix spans fmrigds (BIDS-aware subject keying + multi-file h5 stacking) and fmrireg (add fmri_meta.group_data_fmrilm).
set.title: Canonical group_data() does not round-trip write_results() output
